items.title: Nostalgia Fest Expo
items.summary: Nostalgia Fest is taking over Square One for three massive days! Get ready for an exciting weekend of trading cards, collectibles, nostalgia, entertainment and community at the Square One Event Hall in Mississauga . Explore a huge lineup of vendors, artists, special guests, activities, giveaways and more! WHAT YOU'LL FIND AT NOSTALGIA FEST?

items.title: The Perfect Bite
items.summary: The Perfect Bite , presented by Secret City in collaboration with Netflix , brings its sold-out murder mystery dinner experience to Mississauga, inspired by the thrilling world of Netflix's Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery. Step into an exclusive culinary event hosted by acclaimed Chef Maribelle Moore , where a delicious four-course meal quickly becomes the scene of a gripping mystery . Interact with live actors, uncover secrets, and become part of the story as the evening unfolds around you.

items.title: Kids Craft & Play — Erin Mills Town Centre
items.summary: Celebrate Thanksgiving weekend at Erin Mills Town Centre with a fun-filled family festival featuring interactive activities, local vendors, entertainment, and plenty of opportunities to make lasting memories together. Taking place on October 10-11 2026 , the Thanksgiving Family Festival brings together shopping, community spirit, and family-friendly entertainment in a festive atmosphere designed for all ages. Visitors can enjoy a wide variety of activities throughout the day, making it the perfect long weekend outing for families.

items.title: Diwali RazzMatazz
items.summary: Celebrate the magic of Diwali with an unforgettable night of culture, colour, and energy. From dazzling performances and vibrant fashion to music that keeps you moving all night long, this is where tradition meets celebration in the most electrifying way. Expect live entertainment, high-energy DJ sets, delicious festive bites, and a space filled with lights, style, and celebration. Whether you’re coming for the culture, the atmosphere, or the memories, RazzMatazz is the place to be this Diwali.

items.title: Kahaani Cafe: Table #7
items.summary: Kahaani Cafe: Table #7 , presented by ArtsyCulture Society , returns this October with a captivating new chapter of theatre, storytelling, and live music. Set within the warm ambiance of an intimate café, this unique stage production weaves together nostalgia, compelling narratives, and live musical performances to create a deeply moving experience. One table. Endless emotions. At the heart of the evening is an exceptional live band, guiding audiences through a rich and immersive musical journey.

items.title: Sculpt A Succulent Garden
items.summary: Create a beautiful handcrafted succulent arrangement in this Air-Dry Clay Succulent Sculpture Workshop! Participants will learn how to sculpt realistic succulent shapes using air-dry clay, exploring techniques for shaping, texturing, and assembling layered botanical forms. Once complete, the clay succulents will be arranged in a charming terracotta tray to create a modern decorative centerpiece.

items.title: From Garden to Ital Table: Caribbean-Inspired Cooking Workshop
items.summary: An interactive workshop that invites participants to transform fresh seasonal produce into simple, nourishing Caribbean-inspired dishes.

items.title: Luna Halloween Market
items.summary: The Luna Halloween Market: Night of the Vampire brings a weekend of Halloween-themed shopping, entertainment, and family-friendly activities to the Vic Johnston Community Centre. 🌙🖤 Visitors can explore more than 45 unique vendors , immersive vampire-themed photo opportunities, and a variety of spooky attractions throughout the market. Highlights include the 🩸 Blood Bar serving Halloween-inspired beverages, 🍬 Dracula's Candy Bar , the 🎃 Vampire's Cauldron Kids Prize Station , and a 🦇 Vampire Scavenger Hunt with prizes to be won.

items.title: The Musical Journey of Neil Diamond featuring Jay White
items.summary: VaughnCo Entertainment proudly presents the world’s most authentic Neil Diamond concert tribute, starring Jay White! For more than five decades, Neil Diamond’s music has transcended generations, touching the hearts of millions around the world. ” Every sound, every gesture, and every note captures the power and emotion that define Neil Diamond’s legendary music. Visually stunning and comfortingly familiar, this extraordinary concert experience is a true feast for the senses—and the soul.
